## D — Accuracy and source flags: Emergencies, malfunctions and crashes

Source basis: every knowledge block names one physical page of the hash-bound South Dakota handbook; the sentence is paraphrased and is not an official question.
A separate same-model fact-check receipt records each draft fact and its qualifier review before outbox submission; independent factual QA remains pending.
Preserve ABS versus nonABS guidance, skid and pavement-return conditions, gentle parking-brake application/release if skidding, malfunction step ordering, warning-device distance, injury-movement exceptions and parked-property reporting obligations. Engine-off and brake-warning-light instructions remain publication claims requiring vehicle-specific review. [A57] [A58] [A59] [A60]
The cover lacks extracted text and is not visually cleared. The edition observation is on the back matter; no image-only content was converted into a learner fact.
Unknown official exam statistics remain null. No legal or clinical opinion is asserted beyond the official handbook’s own driving guidance.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page58 says turn off the engine for a stuck accelerator and after unsuccessful parking-brake response; confirm applicable vehicle controls and safe sequence without confusing Off with the prohibited moving-vehicle Lock position. Brake-warning meanings also require the applicable vehicle manual before categorical learner release.
The injury/fatal-crash violation ranking on physical page60 has no year or dated dataset in the selected text. Do not present it as current measured crash causation.
